videos.description:
Blizzard wants to change how a Moonkin levels in WoW Forever. On the official podcast, designer Kris Zierhut walked through a proposal for Balance Druid's talents.

• He said Balance's talent flow works badly while leveling.
• The pushback talent sits over in the Restoration tree, and Improved Starfire takes five points in a crowded row.
• His fix: fold Starfire's cast time reduction into the first-row Wrath talent. He called combining those two "probably the right call".
• Then move Moonfury's 10% damage into Moonkin Form itself.
• He also warned that this much change is risky for a hotfix, so some of it may wait for a patch.

videos.description:
Is multiboxing allowed in WoW Forever? Yes: playing several accounts at once doesn't break Blizzard's rules. Each account needs its own copy of the game and its own game time, all on the same Battle.net account. What's banned is input broadcasting: software that copies one key press to every window (2020) and hardware that does the same (2021). Blizzard's rule of thumb: one key press, one action. Blizzard hasn't published separate rules for Forever, so the existing policy applies, with warnings, suspensions and account closures.
